ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout, Charan Kumar, Pavan Kalyan
Sigmainfo: Magesh R, Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury
Agenda
Learn your feedback and update on evaluation
Discuss next steps about your timelines and purchase interest
Key Takeaways
A significant drop in impressions on landing pages was observed due to a recent Google algorithm change, even though blog traffic and ranked long-tail queries remain strong.

Revamping the product engineering services landing page is prioritized, with plans to develop cornerstone blog content for fintech and investment software development to stabilize fluctuating rankings.
Review and optimization of FAQ schema markup on landing pages were requested to improve visibility in featured snippets despite evolving AI-driven search results.
A robust lead tracking and conversion funnel report is required to understand user journeys from CTA clicks to form submissions, ensuring leads are generated from targeted pages and regions.

A follow-up meeting is scheduled for tomorrow at 11:30 to deep dive into technical fixes, conversion improvements, and to add long-tail, industry-specific keywords for ecommerce content in Australia and New Zealand.
Business Need
Revamp product engineering services landing pages with additional long-tail and industry-specific keywords to improve ranking and conversion.
Implement detailed lead conversion analysis by tracking CTA events and optimizing the user funnel to generate higher quality leads.
Impact
Google algorithm update now shows only the top 10 results, causing a drop in impressions for pages ranked beyond position 10; overall blog traffic increased by up to 25% from July to September.
Spikes in impressions were observed on the accessibility blog on August 19 and October 2, though these impressions did not convert to clicks.
Feature Mention
Enhance landing pages with FAQs enriched with semantic and secondary keywords; review and optimize FAQ schema to improve feature snippet performance.
Implement event tracking on every CTA to capture funnel data from page visit through form submission.

Competitor

Decision Making
Sandeep instructed the team to obtain an intermediate update from Magesh on technical fixes by Friday and to share the SEO report for continued tracking.
The team agreed to schedule a follow-up call tomorrow at 11:30 to review the lead funnel and content optimization strategies.
Timeline
Technical fixes by Magesh are expected to be completed by Friday.
Revamp of at least 5 old blogs will commence this month with tag optimizations.
A follow-up call is scheduled for tomorrow at 11:30 to dive deeper into the lead funnel and optimization tasks.
Risk
Risk of severe ranking fluctuations noted, exemplified by product engineering services dropping from first to 27th position.
Potential impact from FAQ schema issues where Google rephrases content, affecting feature snippet visibility.
Technical risks include slow page load times (FCP, LCP, TBT issues) and potential malfunctioning of CTAs affecting conversion.
Positive Moment
Digital lending blog is performing exceptionally well, ranking better than the landing page despite lower direct clicks.
Crawling rate improved significantly from 60% to 82%, indicating better site health.
Pain Point
Fluctuating rankings for product engineering services and investment software development are causing uncertainty in SEO performance.
Inadequate lead conversion with unclear tracking of genuine versus spam leads hampers clear assessment of marketing success.

SEO Performance Insights
Google now displays only the top 10 search results, decreasing impressions for pages ranking beyond that threshold.
Custom Excel reports and various reject queries are being used to extract detailed long-tail query data in AI mode, aiding in performance tracking.
Keyword Optimization Strategy
Product engineering services landing page dropped from #1 to #27; planning to revamp pages with additional long-tail semantic keywords.
Fintech cornerstone blog and investment software development keywords are to be optimized by adding more long-tail search intent terms.
Technical SEO Enhancements
Review and optimize FAQ schema markup to improve feature snippet visibility and better harness Google AI rephrasing.
Address technical loading issues by optimizing FCP, LCP, and TBT through reducing heavy content and improving server response.
Improve crawling and indexing by monitoring the crawling rate, now improved from 60% to 82%, and tagging new and revamped blogs.
Content Strategy for Australia and New Zealand
Develop blog topics tailored to the ecommerce sector in Australia and New Zealand, leveraging local address and regional trends.
Lead Generation Analysis
Implement tracking events on every CTA to monitor the conversion funnel from initial page visit through form submission.
Plan to categorize leads by page, region, and spam status, and share a weekly leads overview report.
Refine the SEO funnel and conversion steps to boost lead quality and volume for product and fintech landing pages.
